discard.question: Close this window? What you entered will be lost.

forgot.title: Password recovery
forgot.intro: Enter your email address, and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If this address is registered, the letter is on its way — check your inbox

reset.title: New password
reset.done: The password is changed — log in with the new one

verify.title: Email confirmation
verify.resent: The letter is on its way — check your inbox
verify.not_sent: The letter could not be sent. Try again later

error.signup_disabled: Open registration is closed on this installation
error.session_expired: Your session has expired, log in again
error.validation_error: Check the form: some fields are filled in incorrectly
error.password_too_short: The password must be at least 8 characters long
error.missing_token: The link carries no token — copy it from the letter in full
error.invalid_token: This link does not work: it has probably been used already
error.too_many_requests: Too soon: wait a minute and try again

error.network: The server is unavailable. Check your connection and try again
error.no_organization: You do not belong to any organization
error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this
error.category_not_found: No such category in this project
error.task_not_found: No such task in this project
error.task_limit_reached: This project has too many tasks: the cap is reached
error.duration_too_short: The duration must be at least one day
error.category_not_empty: The category still has tasks — move them out first
error.user_not_in_organization: This person is not in your organization
error.calendar_has_no_working_days: The project calendar has no working days at all
error.calendar_too_few_working_days: The project calendar has too few working days for this duration
error.unknown_criticality: There is no such criticality level
error.already_assigned: This person is already assigned to the task
error.assignment_not_found: This person is not assigned to the task anyway
error.negative_position: Nowhere to put the row: the position is negative
error.link_not_found: This link does not work: it was revoked, or the address is wrong
error.sharing_disabled: Public links are switched off in this installation
error.share_link_not_found: The project is not published yet
error.comments_closed: Comments are closed on this page
error.guest_name_required: Enter your name — a comment should not go unsigned
error.too_many_comments: That is too many comments too fast. Please wait a little
error.invite_not_found: No such invitation — check the whole link
error.invite_expired: The link has expired — ask for a new one
error.invite_revoked: The invitation was revoked — ask for a new one
error.invite_accepted: The invitation has already been accepted — just sign in
error.invite_wrong_email: The invitation was issued to a different address
error.invite_rate_limited: Too many invitations this hour — try again later
error.invalid_email: Check the addresses: one of them is empty or is not an email
error.project_ids_need_client_role: Projects are chosen for the client role only
error.mail_failed: The email did not go out — copy the link and send it yourself
error.mail_not_configured: Mail is not configured in this installation
error.mail_disabled: Mail is turned off in this installation
error.offline: No connection to the server: the change was not sent
error.undo_conflict: The project has changed — undoing would take back the wrong step
error.invite_for_another_address: The invitation is addressed to someone else
error.role_not_invitable: That role cannot be handed out by a link
error.verification_not_found: That confirmation link no longer works
error.llm_schema_mismatch: The model did not answer in the expected shape — try again
error.llm_bad_json: The model's answer could not be read
error.llm_bad_shape: The model's answer is missing expected fields
error.llm_key_unreadable: The key cannot be decrypted: APP_SECRET changed
error.api_key_required: A key is required for the first connection
error.wrong_step: That step is not finished yet
error.already_applied: The draft has already been applied
error.interview_exhausted: No questions left — move on to the summary
error.share_not_found: The link does not work or was revoked
error.public_sharing_disabled: Public links are switched off in this installation
error.comment_author_required: There is no one to sign this comment
error.slug_empty: That makes no address — use letters or digits

live.offline: No connection to the server. Editing is unavailable
live.offline_since: No connection, showing data as of {time}. Editing is unavailable

empty.title: No projects yet
empty.hint: Create the first project — categories and tasks will live inside it

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.greeting: Hello, {name} — here is your portfolio at a glance

empty.title: Nothing is assigned to you
empty.hint: Tasks where you are an assignee will gather here, across every project

panel.name: Name
panel.delete_warning: The task will be deleted along with its links, assignees and comments. Undo can bring it back

new.title: New task
new.name: Name
new.partial: The task itself is already created — retrying will only add what is left.

schedule.title: Set the start date
schedule.holidays_note: Days off and holidays come from the organization and project settings — the dates are computed around them.
schedule.tasks_shift: Shift all tasks along with the start
schedule.tasks_keep: Keep task dates as they are

relative.hint: Plan the timeline now. Assign a start date when the project is approved.

gantt.empty: This project has no categories yet. Create a category — tasks live inside it

summary.late: The project ends {end} — {days} after the {deadline} deadline

gantt.caption: The magenta tick is the original deadline; the “+N d” label shows how far the date slipped. A magenta arrow is a violated dependency: the task started before its blocker was done.

share.title: Public link to the project
share.hint: The link opens the project for reading without an account: no internal notes, no assignees
share.reissue_warning: A new link kills the old one instantly — an address you already sent will stop opening
share.reissued: Link reissued — the old one no longer opens
share.revoke_warning: The project stops opening for everyone the link was sent to. You can publish it again — the address will be a different one
share.disabled: Public links are switched off: by the installation or by the organization

comments.title: Comments
comments.closed: The project owner has closed comments

invite.title: Invite to the organization
invite.emails_hint: Several at once — separated by commas or line breaks
invite.link_only_hint: With no address you get a link invitation: it belongs to whoever opens it
invite.projects_hint: A client sees only the projects ticked here

action.reissue_warning: The old link dies at once: whoever already received it will not be able to open it
action.revoke_warning: The invitation stops working: the link you sent will no longer let anyone in

issued.once: Copy the link now: there is nowhere to take it a second time — the server keeps only its fingerprint

accept.title: Invitation
accept.bearer: This is a link invitation: it works for whoever opened it
accept.wrong_account: The invitation was issued to {email}. Sign out and sign in with that address

plan.reapprove_warning: Re-approving moves the baseline: shifts will be measured from the new dates
plan.beyond_plan_explained: Added after the plan was approved — there is no baseline to compare with

shift.title: Shift of {days}
shift.explain: “{name}” moves further from the approved plan than the {threshold} threshold. Say why — the reason stays in the task history

undo.stale: The project has changed: this move can no longer be undone

settings.threshold_hint: A change that moves further than this from the approved plan needs a reason
settings.working_days_empty: At least one day of the week has to stay a working day
settings.slug_taken: That address is taken. A free one:

org.title: Organization settings
org.read_only: Only the owner can change these
org.name: Name
org.holidays_hint: Non-working dates, one per line. Applies to every project
org.comments: Comments on public links are on by default

project.title: Settings for “{name}”
project.name: Name
project.holidays_extra_hint: Applied on top of the organization calendar
project.delete_warning: The project will be deleted entirely — categories, tasks and all of its history. This cannot be undone

profile.title: Profile
profile.timezone_hint: Today is worked out in this zone: the today line on the chart, the plan mark on a task and overdue dates

llm.title: LLM connection
llm.hint: The address and the model are settings: a local model works too
llm.key_set: A key is set. Leave empty to keep it

ai.title: New project through an interview
ai.intro: The system asks one question at a time and ends with a draft of categories and tasks. Nothing is written into a project until you apply it
ai.not_configured: No LLM is connected: the key is set in the organization settings

summary.title: What I understood
summary.hint: This is the cheapest place to catch a misunderstanding — before it turns into a hundred wrong tasks

draft.title: Draft plan
draft.hint: Nothing is written into a project until you press Apply
